title: DNA 1: Finale
description:
Who Will Remain Standing!? Omni-Leo V.S. Terror Terius!? Find Out on the Last Episode of DNA 1!

Play the final episode of DNA 1 where you play as Omni-Leo in the epic finale showdown against Terror Terius, the symbol of darkness...who will remain standing?

At Last the True Power of Leo's DNA Has Awoken!
• Finish DNA 1's epic finale in an ultimate boss battle unlike any you have ever played before...

• Find out who will remain in the grand showdown between Omni-Leo and Terror Terius.

• Clash with darkness and discover the fate of the world...

Rise Leo...
• Finish off DNA 1 with the finale's enticing gameplay!

• Experience the ultimate challenge building upon all of DNA 1's rewarding difficulties.

• Discover the true power within Leo...

Battle the Epic Final Showdown in the Cosmos!
• End DNA 1 in a gripping, remarkable finale beyond the Earth!

• Take the final fight to the cosmos and find out who shall remain standing in the end!

• So, who will remain standing...?
description_short: DNA 1 is a hand drawn episodic beat up up anime game created by a Solo Developer. Play as the protagonist Leo, a genetically modified with Extraterrestrial life Elite Nova Corp Troop, as he faces challenges on what path he must take to change his life. Thus begins the epic story of DNA!
